tier_reason: Raised C to A: the utf8_range tables in the protobuf README come from the original cyb70289/utf8 repo, whose benchmark code, compiler (gcc 7.3), flags (Makefile -O3 -march=native) and CPU (Xeon E5-2650) are public for the SSE4 rows; the tables are from 2018 and predate the 2020 lookup/range optimizations.
